root.label: Hegseth announces one-day military voting stand-down

events.label: Hegseth announces one-day military voting stand-down

slots.name: voting day off
slots.sentence: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced on Friday that all U.S. troops will get one day off in October to vote in the 2026 midterm elections.

slots.name: troops not registered
slots.sentence: stating that about 300,000 troops did not register to cast votes two years ago.

slots.name: stand-down duration
slots.sentence: Pete Hegseth, the US defense secretary, announced today that there will be a “one-day stand-down” this month, for service members to vote in the upcoming midterm elections.
